purpose: ATLAS Knowledge Bank NIST public-data discovery and provenance layer. This catalog intentionally distinguishes public-data repositories from copyrighted/licensed NIST Standard Reference Data products.

verification.provider: National Institute of Standards and Technology
verification.rule: Public Data Repository records may be discovered and linked with record-level metadata and terms. NIST Standard Reference Data is separately licensed/copyrighted and must not be bulk-copied or treated as unrestricted public-domain data.

resources.title: NIST Public Data Repository
resources.storage_policy: metadata_and_link_by_default; download only public record files under record-level terms

resources.title: NIST Science Data Portal
resources.storage_policy: discovery/index only; individual records must be verified before cataloging

resources.title: Public Access to NIST Research
resources.storage_policy: index only; follow linked publication/data repository rights and embargo rules

resources.title: NIST Standard Reference Data Catalog
resources.storage_policy: metadata_and_link_only unless explicit SRD license permits additional use; no systematic bulk downloading
resources.rights_note: NIST SRD may be copyrighted and subject to separate terms; free web access does not imply unrestricted redistribution.
